verses.context: Recalling how God rescued people who cried out to him in distress, this psalm calls on them to actually thank him for it.

KJV.text: I sought the Lord, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.

BSB.text: I sought the LORD, and He answered me; He delivered me from all my fears.
BSB.displayText: I sought the LORD, and He answered me; He delivered me from all my fears.

CPDV.text: I sought the Lord, and he heeded me, and he carried me away from all my tribulations.

verses.context: Written after David escaped a dangerous situation by pretending to be insane, this verse recalls him seeking God and finding relief from fear.

KJV.text: Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.

BSB.text: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast and immovable. Always excel in the work of the Lord, because you know that your labor in the Lord is not in vain.

CPDV.text: And so, my beloved brothers, be steadfast and unmovable, abounding always in the work of the Lord, knowing that your labor is not useless in the Lord.
CPDV.displayText: And so, my beloved brothers, be steadfast and unmovable, abounding always in the work of the Lord, knowing that your labor is not useless in the Lord.

verses.context: Closing his long chapter on the resurrection, Paul tells the Corinthians that their efforts for God are never ultimately wasted.
